data.name: Car Crime Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
data.detailed_description:
Crime Car Simulator: Early Days is a free prologue to the full game.

Dirty Jack, a man with a shady past, has just opened a small garage in Winston Springs. Fresh out of prison, he’s trying to stay on the legal side… at least for now. He’ll introduce you to the basics of running the business - but it quickly becomes clear his ambitions go far beyond honest work.




In the prologue, you’ll take your first steps in balancing legal repairs with less official opportunities. Fix cars for customers, earn your first money, and start exploring ways to grow your operation.


Learn the fundamentals of diagnosing issues, repairing vehicles, and preparing them for sale. The available tools and options will be limited, but enough to give you a taste of what’s to come.


You’ll also get an introduction to more questionable activities - acquiring cars through unofficial means, handling them discreetly, and turning them into profit. Just remember: this is only the beginning.


If you play your cards right, in the full game you’ll expand far beyond a small garage…

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 5 3000
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 / Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.5 Ghz or Ryzen 7 5000 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070 / Radeon RX 6800
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
